Outbound._comment: CHO hosts this service calls that are neither a Services:* URL nor under *.cloudhealthoffice: the in-cluster names its other base-URL settings and code defaults use. Only these hosts receive CHO tokens (docs/security/service-auth-rollout-playbook.md).

PaymentRuns._comment: Stranded claim reservations: auto-release only for Failed/Cancelled runs past the grace period with no payment and no 835; runs Running past the stuck threshold, and everything else, are flagged for a second approver.
